ramp.xds

Source: vignettes/xds.Rmd
xds.Rmd

First, we define F_season and change the mean value of Lambda. To set up a seasonality function, we pass a parameter set from ramp.trace::makepar_F_sin:

library(ramp.xds)
library(ramp.trace)
Lo = list(
       Lambda=400, 
       season_par=makepar_F_sin()
      )

We use the first model as a template for the new model, but we assign the return value a new name model so that the original one still exists:

model <- xds_setup( Loptions = Lo)
model <- burnin(model)

Now, we solve to get the orbits every five days over a three-year period.

model <- xds_solve(model, Tmax=365*3, dt=5)

After solving, we can plot the orbits.

par(mfrow = c(1,2))
xds_plot_X(model)
xds_plot_M(model)
xds_plot_Y(model, add=T)
xds_plot_Z(model, add=T)
